summary: First-finish smoke testing of KMB STORE (backend + frontend + admin). Backend: all 3 GET endpoints (products=24 across 6 brands, config with 14 communes, reviews=6) return 200. Single product GET works. Admin login: wrong password -> 401, admin123 -> 200. All admin-protected endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE /api/products, PUT /api/config/communes, POST /api/upload) reject requests without X-Admin-Password (401) and accept with correct header. Full product CRUD lifecycle verified (create->update->delete). Image upload to object storage returns url; GET /api/files/{path} returns image/png bytes (69B). Frontend: Home loads with hero/search/32 cards; search filter works (Jordan filter -> 6 cards); product card click navigates to /produit/:id. On product page: before selection incomplete-error is visible and WhatsApp/Wave buttons are disabled; after selecting size 37 + commune Abobo, summary-total updated to '44 000 FCFA' (42000+2000) and both order buttons became enabled. Add-to-cart clicked and cart drawer auto-opened. Admin page: password login with admin123 shows dashboard (product list rendered) and add-product modal opens with all fields.
passed: PUT /api/config/communes updates fees (accepts JSON array body)
POST /api/upload returns url; GET /api/files/{path} returns image bytes
Frontend home loads with hero + search + product grid
incomplete-error shown & order buttons disabled before selection
Selecting size + commune enables order buttons and updates summary-total (44 000 FCFA)
Add-to-cart works; cart drawer opens with item
Admin login (admin123) shows dashboard and add-product modal opens
notes: PUT /api/config/communes expects a raw JSON array body (List[Commune]), not an object wrapper. Frontend already sends the correct shape via api.js.
Test overwrote communes list during backend testing but was restored to seeded 14 communes afterwards.
